# mkrfc

> CLI tool for creating and managing project RFCs (Requests for Comments). Stores RFCs as Markdown files with YAML frontmatter in `docs/rfc/`. Provides interactive TUI forms for creation and resolution.

Install: `go install github.com/flaticols/mkrfc@latest`

## Commands

- `mkrfc` — if no RFCs exist, run `mkrfc new`; otherwise run `mkrfc list`
- `mkrfc new` — interactive form to create a new RFC (template, title, summary, optional sections)
- `mkrfc list` — list all RFCs in a table (NUM, TITLE, STATUS, DATE, AUTHORS)
- `mkrfc list --status <STATUS>` — filter list by status
- `mkrfc resolve` — interactive form to transition a draft RFC (select RFC, pick new status, add note)
- `mkrfc review` — add a reviewer to a draft RFC; optionally approve or reject it
- `mkrfc approve` — alias for `mkrfc review`
- `mkrfc templates` — list available templates (built-in + custom)
- `mkrfc llm` — print compact XML reference (commands, frontmatter, template data, behavior, examples)
- `mkrfc help` — show usage

## RFC Storage

- RFCs are written to `docs/rfc/` as `NNNN-slug.md` (e.g. `0001-add-async-job-queue.md`)
- Custom templates go in `docs/rfc/.templates/*.md`
- The default template is embedded in the binary

## Frontmatter Schema

Each RFC file has YAML frontmatter:

```yaml
---
title: "RFC Title"
authors:
  - "Name <email>"
reviewers: []
status: "DRAFT"
date: "2024-01-15"
resolved_date: ""   # set by mkrfc resolve
tags: []
---
```

## Status Values

- `DRAFT` — active proposal under discussion
- `ACCEPTED` — approved
- `REJECTED` — declined
- `SUPERSEDED` — replaced by another RFC

## mkrfc new — Optional Sections

During `mkrfc new`, a multi-select picker lets you choose which sections to include. Pre-selected defaults: Motivation, Proposed Implementation, Drawbacks, Alternatives.

Available section keys:
- `motivation`
- `implementation`
- `metrics`
- `drawbacks`
- `alternatives`
- `impact`
- `unresolved`
- `conclusion`

Sections not selected are omitted from the output entirely. The template checks `{{ if index .Sections "key" }}`.

## mkrfc new — PR Auto-detection

If `gh` CLI is installed and the current branch has an open pull request, `mkrfc new` automatically adds the PR URL to the RFC frontmatter (`pr:` field) and renders a link in the header table.

## mkrfc review

Flow:
1. Picks from DRAFT RFCs
2. Prompts for reviewer name (pre-filled from git config)
3. Prompts for action: "Add as reviewer" / "Approve (ACCEPTED)" / "Reject (REJECTED)"
4. If approve or reject: prompts for a note, appends `## Resolution` section
5. Writes updated RFC back to disk

## Template Data

The default template (Go text/template) receives:

- `{{.Title}}` — RFC title
- `{{.Author}}` — git config user.name + user.email
- `{{.Date}}` — creation date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `{{.Summary}}` — one-line summary from form
- `{{.PR}}` — PR URL (auto-detected from gh CLI, empty if none)
- `{{.Sections}}` — `map[string]bool` of selected optional sections; checked with `{{ if index .Sections "key" }}`
- Optional content fields (empty by default): `{{.TargetServices}}`, `{{.Motivation}}`, `{{.Implementation}}`, `{{.Metrics}}`, `{{.Drawbacks}}`, `{{.Alternatives}}`, `{{.Impact}}`, `{{.Unresolved}}`, `{{.Conclusion}}`

## resolve behavior

`mkrfc resolve`:
1. Scans `docs/rfc/` for DRAFT RFCs
2. Presents a picker (select RFC, select new status, enter note)
3. Updates the frontmatter `status` and `resolved_date`
4. Appends a `## Resolution` section with status, date, and note

## Auto-numbering

`NextNumber` scans existing `NNNN-*.md` files, takes the maximum number + 1. Returns 1 if the directory is empty or does not exist.

## Custom Templates

Drop any `.md` file (Go text/template syntax) into `docs/rfc/.templates/`. When multiple templates exist, `mkrfc new` shows a template picker first. Built-in templates are marked `(built-in)`.

## Module

- Module path: `github.com/flaticols/mkrfc`
- Go 1.24+
- Dependencies: `github.com/charmbracelet/huh`, `gopkg.in/yaml.v3`
- Internal packages: `internal/rfc`, `internal/tpl`, `internal/cmd`

## Examples

```
mkrfc                              # new RFC if none exist, else help
mkrfc new                          # create RFC interactively
mkrfc list                         # list all RFCs
mkrfc list --status DRAFT          # show only drafts
mkrfc resolve                      # resolve a draft RFC
mkrfc templates                    # show available templates
```

## Non-interactive (non-TTY) mode

When stdin is not a TTY (piped input, CI), interactive TUI forms are skipped. Pass flags instead:

```
mkrfc new --title "My RFC" [--summary TEXT] [--template NAME] [--sections motivation,implementation]
mkrfc resolve --rfc 1 --status ACCEPTED [--note TEXT]
mkrfc review --rfc 1 --action accept [--reviewer NAME] [--note TEXT]
```

`mkrfc list` always works non-interactively.
